inspection.method: Full-resolution review of the S129-touched surfaces (desktop and mobile depth chart in both themes, roster, public landing with the weekly-challenge row) at 74683a57; the same surfaces were reviewed at f4179d69, where the two defects below were found. Captures were taken with an uncommitted copy of responsive-evidence.mjs that only raises the realism-verify wait from 120 s to 360 s: a one-season verify takes about 160 s on this host at both S128 and S129, so the tracked script timed out on host speed, not a regression.
findings: f4179d69 mobile depth chart: zero flex basis on the player cell squeezed names to one letter per line (present since the S129 depth rebuild).
f4179d69 desktop depth chart: the 54 px snap-share input showed 100 as 10( because the number spinner took its room.
fixesApplied: 74683a57: player cell flex basis 10rem on phones; names read on one line.
74683a57: spinner hidden and padding trimmed on the snap-share input; 100 shows in full and 1280 px overflow stays 0.
